title: About this site
author: Richard Moon
exact_source_text: QuantumAikido.com is a website about Richard Moon's body of work — fifty years on the mat, a decade of peace negotiations across three continents, thirty years of executive leadership coaching. Moon applied Aikido and Dialogue principles to executive leadership in more than fifty major corporations. WIGO is Richard's primary inquiry framework, developed across fifty years of Aikido practice and refined through executive coaching in the 1990s. The Quantum Pause is the interval between stimulus and response — the space Viktor Frankl identified from inside a concentration camp as the location of human freedom. In the mid-1990s Richard joined a team attempting track-two diplomacy between Greek Cypriot and Turkish Cypriot community leaders. His coaching clients have included Apple Computer, Intel, Motorola, Lawrence Livermore Laboratories, Chevron Research, McCaw Cellular, Nextel Communications, and Scandinavian Air Systems. He taught in the University of Texas San Antonio Graduate School of Business for Professional Excellence for seventeen years.
